scope: NR metric-definition development audit; not author-denominator identification or baseline validation
reconstruction_choices: Use paper p.11 horizontal observation radius 6000 ft, inclusive at the radius, with the existing spherical distance_m. Do not substitute the 6080 ft Fig.4 label or filter potential encounters by altitude.

All physical exposure is integrated from complete interval-start truth immediately before the original bs.sim.step, after admissions. Call original step exactly once and use its actual dt. No decisions, trajectories, accepted targets, guidance or simulator arrays are changed.

Potential, LoWC and NMAC retain unordered pair-seconds and directed values exactly twice those numerators. LoWC/NMAC use original risk_flags and must exactly match the native environment tracker. Continuous sampled pair episodes are counted separately from duration.

Retain aircraft_seconds=sum(active aircraft*dt), all airspace_seconds=sum(dt), and occupied_airspace_seconds=sum(dt when any aircraft is active). Empty intervals count in the complete airspace denominator. Report both aircraft-hour and complete-airspace-hour rates; occupied-airspace-hour rates are separately labelled auxiliary diagnostics.

LoWC/potential and NMAC/potential are ratios of exposure durations, not independent-event probabilities. Directed potential seconds per aircraft-hour can exceed 3600 with multiple simultaneous neighbors.

Record every actual env.observations construction, including reset, terminal previews before deletion, and step-return construction. Separately count returned reset/decision frames and terminal payload entries. Empty final frames count as returned frames. These counts are neither policy inference nor safety exposure; actual NR policy inference calls are zero.
Wrap only the two instance call facades temporarily and restore their exact original instance namespace entries in finally. Do not request any additional observations for this audit.

Compare every original NR summary field exactly against the first reference line except wall_seconds and process_peak_rss_mib. Audit-only counters remain outside the original NR summary. Preserve failed flights, mismatches and exception diagnostics.

Aggregate the complete fixed twelve-case development set and its existing four five-corridor cases by summing numerators and denominators before division. Do not average case-level rates or select new seeds.

The paper p.17 describes cumulative experience across agents, while p.11 leaves normalization implementation unresolved. Numerical proximity under a changed denominator does not establish the author's denominator. This diagnostic does not resolve that ambiguity or claim the current NR matches the published traffic distribution.
